meals.note: Jester until he joins, then army pairs (Theodora + Loretta + Tobias). Io and Diego share a table: they support each other.

weekly.text: Diego short of Support 2 by 10/15? Seat him at every table: Ch 12 is too late

missables.text: Get Diego to Support 2 before 10/16: check Map > People
missables.lose: the Ch 12 recruit of Diego (he needs Support 2)

missables.text: Be at Renown 8 before Ch 12: Diego needs it, and Part I ends 10/24
detail: Ch 11 usually sits at Renown 9 to 10, so this is a check, not a grind.
Short? Clear all three Paralogues (150 each) and both Send Supplies (350 each) before 10/15.

missables.text: Fight three Paralogues in their windows: Bertrand's by 9/25, Anna's 9/24 to 10/5, Talimun's by 10/12
missables.lose: 20,000G, 150 Renown and the item of each one you miss
detail: Talimun's has two windows: 9/17 to 9/22 or 10/1 to 10/10.

note.text: Take any Ch 10 Advanced exam that waited on Renown 8, Lv 35 or a rank, in priority order
detail: Order: Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias, then Lilian.

override.text: Dragoon carries in from Cai's route (Aurora's mentoring quest)

assign.why: Talimun's Paralogue copy: storage until her Part III
Open slot for the Fire Orb side of this battle
Iapetus Cavern chest: read it at once

note.text: Pack each bench unit's Part II kit now: Nydine, Noctula, Simon, Nuzzuo
detail: Six items at most, main weapon in hand. Each unit's build page lists them.
Buy Noctula's [[item:Da Mina Gauntlets]] now: +2 in Ch 12.

recruits.action: At Support 3 and Renown 10, pay 4,000G and recruit him for his Levin Sword

prep.text: Jester still waiting for Renown 9? His recruit row is in Ch 10

detail: Dragoon already carries in from Cai's path: this pair is for gold and Renown.

paralogue.note: Keep one unit back to catch the thief; its Cleansing Blade is Alexandra's for Part III
detail: Taking the 10/1 window? Run Iapetus Cavern first: Archive θ's Banshee (range 3) pins the thief.

paralogue.note: Break the last ore deposit only when ready

explore.text: [[place:Iapetus Cavern]] (Lv 32, Solidus): Archive θ for Bonaventure, Black-Magic Manual
detail: Run it with your support pairs.

explore.group: Spare Turns: gather for Vandahl, nearest stop first
explore.text: Nuzzuo's bench kit (Zanbato, Flyssa): Bakul ×10, Kimbai ×3, Noa Fruit ×1
Spend any Turns still left on Inn Auto-Activities

tips.text: Hit the upper-left and upper-right switches one at a time
High-Res units go left (Fire Orb), high-Def units go right (ballista)
detail: Alexandra packs her Pure Water (open slot) for the Fire Orb side.

tips.text: Watch for the purple targeting line of Cai's Underworld Burst

loot.text: Afterward, the Sewers dungeon has a [[item:Talisman Shield]] and a Vulnerary

exitExtra.text: Hand in every open Send Supplies quest now: all expire 10/24 and Ch 12 has only about 32 Turns
detail: Your last long free time: finish training and Support here too.
